items.summary: Recommendation: accept containment-only execution this cycle. Preserve existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Reject new proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry, spend, requeues, monetization expansion, and external component adoption because the authoritative candidate list is empty and existing capacity is occupied. Evidence: 198 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, 29 deployments await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request only after human-counsel review, or keep it unsent.

Reviewed the CRO and product-manager-sites plan: preserve it as the current operating disposition. Useful work remains limited to existing measurement, attribution, legal/security evidence, and failure repair-or-close artifacts. Deferred product concepts remain unqueued until capacity, validation, rollback, security, license, and attribution gates clear.

Recommendation: continue financial containment. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, payback, and cost-to-learn remain unknown. Reconcile existing AI-cost records and costs without requesting duplicate telemetry or authorizing spend.
